title: Repeated missed deliveries and driver no-shows
situation: Multiple customers are experiencing repeated delivery failures and driver no-shows requiring immediate logistical intervention before the weekend cut-off.
hypothesis: Couriers failing to deliver and updating false status.

params.reply_en: We are very sorry about the repeated missed deliveries for your order. We are investigating this with our courier partner right now and will provide an update within 24 hours.
params.reply_ar: نعتذر بشدة عن التأخير المتكرر وعدم تسليم طلبك في الموعد. نحن نتابع هذه المشكلة مع شركة الشحن الآن وسنوافيك بالتحديث خلال 24 ساعة.

actions.why: Acknowledge the delivery failures and set expectations for a follow-up.

params.note: Multiple reports of missed delivery appointments and driver no-shows requiring route audit.

actions.why: Escalate persistent courier no-shows to logistics for carrier review.
